source: IMG_5780.MOV (propeller OFF, bare shaft, 30 fps, audio) + data/bare_reverse_hostlog.json

reverse_minus_forward.model: f = a + b t + c dir, 8 points, drift +0.0126 Hz/s (warms up -> faster)

result.motor_asymmetry: reverse -2.19 % with no load; modelled as an extra L293D drop dV0_rev = 0.061 V (extra friction gives the same propeller-on shift; a K change gives -1.2 % instead of -2.0 %)
result.aero: with the propeller the reverse runs +0.57 % FASTER (IMG_5779), so the propeller load is lighter in reverse: aero torque -19 % (kD_r 1.67 vs kD 3.61). The BEMT cup ground-effect prediction (+12 % torque, -2 % speed) is contradicted.

adc_check.conclusion: propeller off, no flag: 73.6 Hz (ADC commutator ripple / 3), confirms the audio 71.7-72.6 Hz (not 35.85). IMG_5759 (61.4 Hz) had a tape flag: its drag took ~12 Hz, so the joint-fit viscous b (7.7e-7) is mostly flag drag.
